name: Uttarakhand Tourism and Travel Business Registration Rules
benefit: Under this initiative, tourism-related businesses and services within the state are registered online through the Department of Tourism.
_eligibility_text: The following units are eligible for registration under the Rules: - **Residential Units:** Hotels, motels, resorts, guest houses, dharamshalas, ashrams, etc. - **Travel Trade-related Units:** Travel agents, domestic tour operators, excursion agents. - **Catering-related Units:** Restaurants, beer bars, fast food centres, food plazas, food courts, etc. - **Entertainment-related Units:** Amusement/theme parks, golf courses, ropeways, sound and light shows, angling units, etc. - A**dventure Tourism-related Units:** Adventure tour operators, kayaking, canoeing, water sports, river rafting, wall climbing, mountaineering, rock climbing, paragliding, etc. - **Other Units:** Handicraft/souvenir shops, yoga and meditation centres/sadhana kutirs, tourist information centres, and nature/adventure/wildlife photography units, etc.
